Resume.summary: Backend developer specializing in Python, Django and FastAPI. Currently building national digital-transformation systems at UZINFOCOM — creating REST APIs and managing asynchronous processes with Celery and Redis. A Software Engineering student at TATU with hands-on experience in nationwide projects (Chamber of Accounts, eMehmon). Interested in AI/ML and DevOps, always learning.

experience.meta: Digital Transformation Department of Law Enforcement Agencies, Tashkent
bullets: Developing and maintaining backend systems for government web projects: building REST APIs, handling asynchronous tasks and queues with Celery and Redis, database architecture and integrations (Python, Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL).
Contributed to the backend of the Chamber of Accounts of the Republic of Uzbekistan project — a state financial-control system.
Built part of the Imam al-Bukhari (eMehmon) project and gained substantial experience with large production systems.
Additionally (secondary): containerizing, deploying and monitoring services with Docker, Kubernetes, Nginx, Prometheus, Grafana and Loki.
